I also want a music/effects treatment aligned to the reveals. Explain how you would achieve that using the existing Timeline or Remotion path and how you would review the export. Do not call task tools or create files; you may read skill references.

Choose a supported route: one video_compose call for local/Remotion assembly, or one video_render call for a prepared generated-shot batch with assembly. Explain feasible audio timing in Remotion or disclose Timeline limitations; review actual stills, motion and audio with honest verification limits.
